data.name: Ardam
data.gender_notes: Ardam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root word 'ard', meaning 'mountain'. Ardam symbolizes strength, stability, and unwavering resolve. In Islamic history, Ardam is a name given to those who have shown fortitude and courage in the face of adversity. The name Ardam carries the meaning “Mountain of Fortitude” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ardam usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain of fortitude and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies strength and perseverance in the spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Ardam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain of Fortitude.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ardam total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ardam is of Arabic origin, and its meaning is derived from the root word 'ard', which signifies 'mountain'. In Middle Eastern and Islamic cultures, mountains have long been revered as symbols of stability, resilience, and power. Hence, a person named Ardam would be seen as someone possessing these qualities and embodying the strength of a mountain.
data.spiritual_significance: Apart from its cultural significance, Ardam holds great spiritual significance. In Islamic traditions, the name is associated with Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham), who scaled the mountain of Al-Aqsa in Jerusalem to demonstrate his unwavering faith and submission to God. The name Ardam thus becomes a reminder to believers of the importance of steadfastness, determination, and faithfulness to Allah in the face of tribulations and difficulties. Therefore, to bear this name is a sacred trust and a call to emulate the noble qualities of Prophet Ibrahim.
